mathlive 0.111.1 (MIT, see LICENSE), mathlive.min.js and fonts/ unchanged from the npm tarball.

Fetched with:
  npm pack mathlive@0.111.1
  tar xzf mathlive-0.111.1.tgz package/mathlive.min.js package/fonts package/LICENSE.txt

It is loaded only on the first equation edit (js/math-field.js, LAZY_MODULES.mathField),
never in index.html or the boot scripts, and nothing is fetched from a CDN. Fonts come
from this folder (MathfieldElement.fontsDirectory); the keypress sounds are not shipped
(soundsDirectory is null).
